To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) nitrite inhalant abuse is associated with HIV transmission and AIDS-related Kaposi sarcoma in gay men; (2) nitrite inhalants decrease lymphocyte counts and NK cell activity in laboratory animals; and (3) nitrite inhalations may be a candidate "co-factor" in the pathophysiology of AIDS-related Kaposis sarcoma.

nitrites are used in the US and abroad, are associated with behavioral relapses in HIV-positive gay men, and are associated with decreased lymphocyte and natural killer cell counts in vitro, but are not associated with HIV transmission in vivo.
